lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Irregular vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the branchial region, extending across the mid-lateral flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-saturated superior edges and shadow-toned inferior edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs contained within the visible silhouette of the dorsal fin located in the upper-left quadrant.
